# compute_pore_sizes_pocketwise_rust { #mofography.rust_fun.compute_pore_sizes_pocketwise_rust }

```python
rust_fun.compute_pore_sizes_pocketwise_rust(
    dgrid,
    regions_pbc,
    ase_atoms,
    samples_per_region=1000,
    probe_center_min_radius=None,
)
```

Compute pore sizes for each pocket/region separately.

This function samples points within each identified pore region and calculates
the pore size distribution for each region individually.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type          | Description                                          | Default    |
|--------------------|---------------|------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| dgrid              | numpy.ndarray | 3D distance grid from dgrid_from_atoms_rust          | _required_ |
| regions_pbc        | numpy.ndarray | 3D array of region labels from periodic segmentation | _required_ |
| ase_atoms          | ase.Atoms     | ASE Atoms object of the material                     | _required_ |
| samples_per_region | int           | Number of sample points per region label             | `1000`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                 | Description                                         |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        | tuple\[numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray\] | Tuple of (sample_points, pore_sizes, region_labels) |
